name: Flowerdrops
detailed_description:
GROW

Sunrise. It’s time to grow a garden of your own.

As a newly formed cloud, venture out into a lost world filled with strange landscapes to fulfil your singular purpose: blooming flowers. Flowerdrops is a meditative puzzle game with a focus on satisfying physics-based gameplay and strong level variety where you use bouncy raindrops to water flowers. Use the power of your droplets to ricochet off of walls, navigate through obstructions, and ultimately grow as many flowers as you can - turn by turn, stage by stage, drop by drop. An ever expanding suite of environmental hazards and bizarre obstacles means you must plan each shot carefully and make every drop count. Nowhere is too remote, too dangerous, or too absurd for you to grow your flowering friends.

TEND

The world of Flowerdrops is vast and diverse. It is a place that’s often unkind to your droplets and flowers, yet underscored by a serene and self-reflective charm. It is melancholic, playful, and treacherous. Flowerdrops is a meditative experience with a deliberate and relaxing pace, even as it gets trickier. For every new discovery, and with each new complication, new sides of this world’s beauty are revealed. Your curiosity is rewarded. Your playfulness reciprocated.

With this goal in mind, Flowerdrops includes a host of features to help ensure that regardless of your personal skill level or past experience with games, you can find the balance that works best for you:

  • Explore Your Garden: There are many paths through the world of Flowerdrops, and the further you go, the more choices you will have at once. Not feeling a particular level or area? Come back to it later. There’s more than one way to grow this garden.

  • Time Is Yours: Even at its most challenging, Flowerdrops gives you all the time in the world to survey each level and plan accordingly. The game moves as quickly as you do.

  • Player-Driven Difficulty: Flowerdrops does not gate-keep progress behind barriers of difficulty. Avoid or skip levels you’re not interested in, retry as many times as you’d like, and don’t fret about growing every last flower you come across. If your goal is to relax, then relax without judgement. There’s no wrong way to play Flowerdrops.

  • Dialing it In: Seeking a greater challenge? There’s plenty to push your puzzle-solving skills further. Bloom every flower, complete every stage, or uncover unique challenges in the remote corners of the world. Now do it all again in even fewer turns this time. You decide when the challenge is right, and Flowerdrops will meet you at your level.

  • Dress to Impress: Unlock a fun collection of facial features for your little cloud by exploring the world thoroughly. A brand new you might be just what it takes to appreciate things from a whole new perspective.

BLOOM

Whether you’re toppling the highest peaks of difficulty that Flowerdrops has to offer or taking your time to soak in a calming vista, do so to a refined and soft aesthetic. Let the warm allure of the art and the powerfully atmospheric music blanket you just as your raindrops blanket the flowers of this world. Let it all carry you to a feeling of peace and introspection. Where did I come from? What happened to this place? What will I find at the end of it all?

The universe is your garden.

  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
